about: Every file in app/public/vendor, as it was published: its package, version, build, licence, the notice its licence asks to keep (a folder under licenses/ at the repository's root, shipped beside THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md), where it came from and its SHA-256, with the libraries bundled inside it and, on each library, the advisories published against its version, each assessed ("assessments": whether it applies here, why, and what bounds it). A version a bundle does not name is said where it was read ("versionFrom"). app/test/vendor.test.js holds the folder to this list, tools/vendor-sbom.js adds it to the release's SBOM, and tools/vendor-audit.js asks npm's registry for the advisories against each version and fails on a high or critical one not assessed here. A source's integrity is its package's SHA-512, as npm gives it (for SheetJS's own download, taken of the file it serves).

xmldom-parse.why: mammoth parses every part of a Word file with xmldom's DOMParser, so a crafted .docx keeps the page that draws it busy for a long time, or short of memory, until that page is reloaded: the panel of whoever opens it, and every Board panel in the hall, where a file sent into the hall opens itself. The server and the other pages are not affected.
xmldom-parse.mitigation: Today only the upload cap (25 MB a file) and who may send into a hall bound it. In 0.6.0's plan (docs/plan/0.6.0/PLAN.md) unit 23 moves mammoth into a worker the page ends at a deadline, and unit 26 ends a file opening itself on the Board's panel. No mammoth release bundles a fixed xmldom (0.8.15 or later): 1.13.0, the newest, was built with 0.8.6.

xmldom-well-formed.why: mammoth's parse reads such a part instead of refusing it, so the Word file is drawn as it was read.
xmldom-well-formed.mitigation: None is needed today: nothing AGMessage decides rests on a Word file's part being well-formed.

xmldom-serialize.why: mammoth uses xmldom only to parse (DOMParser.parseFromString, in its lib/xml/xmldom.js). It never serializes a DOM with XMLSerializer, never builds one with createElement, setAttribute, createProcessingInstruction or createDocumentType, and writes what XML it writes with xmlbuilder; AGMessage never calls xmldom itself.

jszip-path.why: The traversal needs a program that writes a zip's entries to disk under their own names. mammoth opens the Word file in memory and reads its parts by the names its relationships give; nothing is written anywhere.

underscore-recursion.why: mammoth calls _.flatten only on lists its own readers build, each level flattened as it is read, so the depth _.flatten recurses to is fixed by mammoth's code, never by the document's nesting; and _.isEqual only on a style map's attributes against an element's, both flat. AGMessage passes no style map.
